summary: Stomping Ground is an independent Collingwood brewery with three beer halls and wholesale distribution across Victoria. In March 2026 it raised a crowd-sourced funding round and in October 2026 announced new beer halls (Geelong first, 2027) and a distribution push. Tanvi Aneja is its Finance Manager.

Stomping Ground raises $1.5m in CSF campaign

claims.text: Stomping Ground Brewing Co. is a neighbourhood brewery headquartered in Collingwood, Victoria, founded in 2016.
claims.quote: Stomping Ground Brewing Co is a neighbourhood brewery in Collingwood that brings people together over a great beer.

claims.text: Tanvi Aneja is Finance Manager at Stomping Ground (current), in the role since May 2025.
claims.quote: Finance Manager - Stomping Ground Brewing Co. (Current) May 2025 - Present

claims.text: Tanvi previously worked in finance for Hyatt in Melbourne and as an Industrial Controller at Lactalis Australia.
claims.quote: Currently, I serve as an Industrial Controller at Lactalis Australia, where I manage financial reporting cycles

claims.text: Stomping Ground operates beer halls in Collingwood, Moorabbin and Melbourne Airport.
claims.quote: BEER HALLS COLLINGWOOD 100 Gipps St, Collingwood, VIC 3066

claims.text: In October 2026 the brewery announced plans for new flagship beer halls with Geelong first in 2027, then more across Victoria.
claims.quote: a new growth strategy will see Stomping Ground open new flagship beer halls across metropolitan Melbourne and regional Victoria, with Geelong slated as the first location in 2027

claims.text: The brewery is also planning a major distribution push to place its beers on more taps and retail shelves across Victoria.
claims.quote: the brewery is also planning a major distribution push to place its beers on more taps in hospitality venues and on more retail shelves statewide

claims.text: Stomping Ground completed a $1.5 million crowd-sourced funding campaign supported by more than 640 investors, announced March 2026.
claims.quote: has completed a $1.5 million crowd-sourced funding campaign through OnMarket, supported by more than 640 investors

claims.text: Paul Johns is Senior Management Accountant at Stomping Ground, having been Interim Finance Manager in 2025.
LinkedIn shows Finance as 3 of the brewery's staff and lists Xero in its tech stack.
claims.quote: Tech Stack: google ads, tiktok, repsly, chef, ease, well, xero

hooks.text: Expansion to new beer halls and a distribution push multiplies venue settlements and wholesale AR in the monthly close.
Recent crowd-funding from many investors adds reporting expectations on a small finance team.

risks.text: The Finance Manager ad found earlier is no longer listed and Finance Manager seat history shows turnover (Paul Johns was interim in 2025); check who owns tooling decisions.
Company page lists a parent organisation (Good Drinks Australia), unverified, which could affect buying.

gaps: Finance Manager job ad referenced in CRM no longer appears (0 jobs on Employment Hero).
No posts or podcasts by finance staff found.
Xero tech-stack signal is from a LinkedIn profile only.
